dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Illuga</color> looks like he has something to say...?)

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: How's work with the logistics squad treating you, Ms. Gabieta?

dialogues.speaker: Gabieta
dialogues.text: You needn't worry, Illuga. Everything's going smoothly. Just let me know if the outpost needs anything.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Um... don't you think you were sent here to the logistics squad so you could take it a bit easier?

dialogues.speaker: Gabieta
dialogues.text: That won't do! If I were to "take it easy," those newcomers are really going to turn this place upside down!

dialogues.speaker: Gabieta
dialogues.text: "Sitting back and relaxing" sounds absolutely dreadful. So whatever that old man was thinking, he can drop it right now.
